text: vignette sets formulas package: user cost monetary asset, expenditure shares, Divisia index discrete form Tornqvist Theil, Fisher ideal index, simple sum currency equivalent index, dual user-cost price index Divisia second moments, notation used throughout.

title: Theory and notation
text: monetary asset gives two things: yield monetary services (liquidity). Barnett (1978) prices services yield given . benchmark rate \(R_t\), return asset gives monetary services, rate \(r_{}\) component \(\), user cost one unit held period \(t\) \[ \pi_{} = \frac{R_t - r_{}}{1 + R_t}, \] discounted interest forgone. expenditure monetary services \(E_t = \sum_i \pi_{}x_{}\) share component \(\) \[ s_{} = \frac{\pi_{}x_{}}{E_t}. \] factor \(1/(1 + R_t)\) every component cancels shares. Rates may percent (percent = TRUE) decimal. user costs shares first date simulated data: benchmark rate. \(R_t\) exceed rate every component. benchmark = NULL package takes \(R_t = \max_i r_{}\), version 0.5.0 ; component rate user cost zero. given benchmark package uses \(\max(R_t, \max_i r_{})\), upper envelope.

title: Theory and notation
text: indexes chained: date linked previous one links multiplied, \(Q_1\) equal base. \(\bar{s}_{} = (s_{} + s_{,t-1})/2\): Divisia ("Barnett"). Barnett (1980) aggregates Divisia index, discrete time index Tornqvist (1936) Theil (1967): \[ \log\frac{Q_t}{Q_{t-1}} = \sum_{=1}^{n}\bar{s}_{}\left(\log x_{} - \log x_{,t-1}\right). \] Divisia simple growth ("Hancock"). shares simple growth rates, version 0.5.0: \[ \frac{Q_t}{Q_{t-1}} - 1 = \sum_{=1}^{n}\bar{s}_{}\left(\frac{x_{}}{x_{,t-1}} - 1\right). \] Fisher ideal ("Fisher"). geometric mean Laspeyres Paasche quantity indexes user costs prices (Fisher 1922): \[ \frac{Q_t}{Q_{t-1}} = \left(\frac{\boldsymbol{\pi}_{t-1}^\top\mathbf{x}_t}{\boldsymbol{\pi}_{t-1}^\top\mathbf{x}_{t-1}} \cdot\frac{\boldsymbol{\pi}_t^\top\mathbf{x}_t}{\boldsymbol{\pi}_t^\top\mathbf{x}_{t-1}}\right)^{1/2}. \] Divisia (Tornqvist) Fisher indexes superlative: exact flexible aggregator functions (Diewert 1976), agree closely practice. Simple sum ("SimpleSum"). \(\sum_i x_{}\), usual official aggregate: perfect substitutes, equal weights. Currency equivalent ("CE"). Rotemberg, Driscoll Poterba (1995): \[ CE_t = \sum_{=1}^{n}\frac{R_t - r_{}}{R_t}\,x_{}, \] stock currency give services. Growth. DMAI \(100\log(Q_t/Q_{t-1})\) every method except "Hancock", \(100(Q_t/Q_{t-1} - 1)\). logbase logarithm taken base; version 0.5.0 used base 10 default, gives \(1/\log 10 \approx 0.434\) times growth rate. Level money units. \(V_t = V_1 Q_t/Q_1\) \(V_1 = \sum_i x_{i1}\) (column value).

title: Theory and notation
text: factor reversal user-cost price aggregate \[ P_t = \frac{E_t}{V_t}, \] price times quantity expenditure (component price). Fisher index equals Fisher price index user costs; Divisia index implicit price index.

title: Theory and notation
text: Theil (1967) reads shares probabilities: Divisia growth mean growth rates components, variance \[ K_t = \sum_{=1}^{n}\bar{s}_{}\left(\Delta\log x_{} - \kappa_t\right)^2, \qquad \kappa_t = \sum_{=1}^{n}\bar{s}_{}\,\Delta\log x_{}, \] measures differently components grow. title: Divisia monetary aggregates index — dmai
text: quantities \(x_{}\) components \(= 1, \dots, n\) dates \(t\), rates return \(r_{}\) benchmark rate \(R_t\), user cost component \(\) $$\pi_{} = \frac{R_t - r_{}}{1 + R_t}$$ (Barnett 1978) expenditure share \(s_{} = \pi_{}x_{} / \sum_j \pi_{jt}x_{jt}\). \(\bar{s}_{} = (s_{} + s_{,t-1})/2\), methods "Barnett" Divisia index discrete form Tornqvist Theil (Barnett 1980):     $$\log\frac{Q_t}{Q_{t-1}} = \sum_i \bar{s}_{}\left(\log x_{} - \log x_{,t-1}\right).$$ "Hancock" shares simple growth rates (version 0.5.0):     $$\frac{Q_t}{Q_{t-1}} - 1 = \sum_i \bar{s}_{}\left(\frac{x_{}}{x_{,t-1}} - 1\right).$$ "Fisher" Fisher ideal index, geometric mean Laspeyres Paasche indexes     user costs prices (Fisher 1922; Diewert 1976): $$\frac{Q_t}{Q_{t-1}} = \left(\frac{\sum_i     \pi_{,t-1}x_{}}{\sum_i \pi_{,t-1}x_{,t-1}}\cdot\frac{\sum_i \pi_{}x_{}}{\sum_i     \pi_{}x_{,t-1}}\right)^{1/2}.$$ "SimpleSum" official aggregate \(\sum_i x_{}\). "CE" currency equivalent index \(\sum_i (R_t - r_{})x_{}/R_t\) (Rotemberg, Driscoll Poterba 1995; Barnett 1991). indexes chained equal base first date. growth DMAI \(100\log(Q_t/Q_{t-1})/\log(\mathrm{logbase})\), percent natural logarithm, \(100(Q_t/Q_{t-1} - 1)\) "Hancock". benchmark rate largest rate components date benchmark = NULL (version 0.5.0; component user cost zero), given benchmark, raised largest component rate lower (upper envelope). factor \(1/(1 + R_t)\) common components change shares. dual user-cost price index follows factor reversal, \(P_t = E_t / V_t\), expenditure \(E_t = \sum_i \pi_{}x_{}\) aggregate \(V_t\) units \(x\) (column value).

title: Divisia second moments — dmai_moments
text: dmai_moments() gives Divisia mean variance growth rates components every date (Theil 1967; Barnett Serletis 1990): $$\kappa_t = \sum_i \bar{s}_{}\,\Delta\log x_{}, \qquad K_t = \sum_i \bar{s}_{}\left(\Delta\log x_{} - \kappa_t\right)^2,$$ user costs. large variance means components grow different rates, choice weights matters simple sum poor guide; Barnett Serletis use diagnostic aggregation error.
